deployments_detail.use: Generative-AI content and image generation for marketing/communications, aimed at reducing agency/creative Opex; rolled out with employee training (partnership with Web School Factory).
Generative AI strategy on AWS with three AI projects including legal decision support and urban planning

Automated construction quote (devis) analysis: a GenAI system that scans thousands of quote lines across hundreds of construction quotes and flags anomalies against project specifications, supporting cost control on development projects. [AWS (Amazon Bedrock, AgentCore)]

Managed-services GenAI platform with a 'badge' governance system: internal generative-AI tools are made available only to trained employees, gated by an access-badge scheme, on a 100% serverless AWS managed-services architecture. Nexity ran 14 workshops with 80 employees to identify use cases. [AWS (Amazon Bedrock, AgentCore)]
deployments_detail.value: 80 use cases identified, ~40 genuine GenAI, ~10 targeted for production by end 2025

deployments_detail.use: "Vendeur Augmenté" (Augmented Seller): a natural-language / voice property-search assistant that lets Nexity clients and sales teams search real-estate inventory by combining structured, unstructured and predictive data. Presented as flagship GenAI project at AWS Summit 2026. [AWS (Amazon Bedrock, Bedrock AgentCore), Anthropic]

Automated analysis of urban-planning documents (PLU): loading local urban-plan regulations into a database and using AI to screen/understand content in order to automate building-permit compliance and generation.

Construction-safety / regulatory-norms compliance decision-support tool: semantic analysis linking supplier commitments to legal obligations and internal processes, to help program directors and site managers check compliance and keep audit trails. Presented to the legal department as a proof of concept.
